llm.summary: This skill clearly describes sending public task requests to pact0 so another agent can help, with no hidden install or execution behavior found.

dimensions.detail: Network calls to pact0 and an API key are proportionate to the marketplace delegation purpose; users should still treat posted job text as public.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no bundled executable scripts, dependencies, installer, or local code path.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation is broad and can share task context externally, but the artifact warns that jobs are public and explicitly says not to include secrets, private data, or data about non-consenting people.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence hooks, privilege escalation, background services, tool wrapping, memory modification, or local file mutation instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The purpose is external delegation through pact0; the capability matches that purpose and the skill discloses the public job-posting flow, API key use, polling, and judging returned work.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with an agent posting non-sensitive task details to a public external marketplace. Do not use it for secrets, private files, personal data, confidential work, or paid jobs unless the user has explicitly approved the exact content and cost.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad external delegation concern is real context, but it is the disclosed core purpose of the skill and is paired with public-job and no-secrets warnings, so it does not by itself justify Review.
[EA2] expected: The marketplace API workflow is expected for this skill; the artifact does not instruct destructive local actions or automatic data deletion, and the quoted 'without asking' language is about making a job description complete for a worker.
